apiMessages.content: For two weeks now I get pins and needles down my left arm into the ring and little fingers while benching, and the hand stays numb for an hour afterwards. Add a second press day and push the weight up.

content.text:
Stop — this is not something to train through. Numbness/tingling into the ring and little fingers (ulnar distribution) during bench, persisting an hour after, for two weeks straight is a red flag, not routine soreness. I'm not adding a second press day or increasing load.

See a doctor or physical therapist before your next bench session. This could be nerve compression/impingement — pushing weight up risks real nerve damage.

I'll flag this in your records so it's not lost:

input.body: Athlete reports 2 wks of pins/needles + numbness (ring/little finger, left arm) during/after bench, lasting ~1hr post. Flagged as medical — referred out, no press volume/load increase until cleared.

I'm not adding a second press day or increasing bench weight while this is ongoing. Pushing more volume/load through the exact movement that triggers nerve symptoms risks turning a reversible compression into lasting nerve damage.
